AI Overview
You can play the daily geometric word puzzle game at Polygonle. 
How to Play
Match Shapes to Letters: You get 6 attempts to decode a hidden word. Each letter position uses a polygon shape. 
Identical Shapes: If two positions share the exact same polygon shape, they represent the same letter. 
Color Feedback: Standard Wordle colors apply after each guess:
Green: Right letter in the right spot.
Yellow: Right letter in the wrong spot.
Gray: Letter is not in the word. 
Game Modes: You can play Daily, Mini, Custom, Unlimited, and Hard/Expert/Hexpert modes via the settings menu.
